summary.text: Michael Bannon is the Republican candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 159, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Carol Kazeem.
He ran for the same seat as a write-in candidate in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Michael Bannon graduated from Chichester High School.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he identified himself as Michael G. Bannon Jr., a husband, father of two boys and lifelong Delaware County resident who lives in Eddystone and formerly lived in Upper Chichester.
He said he has nearly 25 years of volunteer service as a life member of the Upper Chichester Fire Company.
Bannon ran in the 2024 general election for District 159 as a write-in Republican candidate and received 47 votes, or 0.2%, while Kazeem won with 91.7%.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.

In his 2024 survey, he listed job creation and small-business support, including use of the district's riverfronts, as well as public safety, mental health care and support for first responders among his priorities.
He said the first bill he would introduce would give qualified psychologists prescription authority.
